name: local-time-popover
title: Local time popover
description: Show an event time in everyone's time zone: a popover from the time itself lists the same moment in your zone and the zones you choose.
docs: Pass instant (an ISO string with its offset, or a Z), zones ({ id, label }; the id is an IANA name such as America/Los_Angeles) and, as you need them, eventZone (default: the first zone), viewerZone, locale, format, now and title. The trigger is a button holding a real time element written in the event's zone, by default as '17:00 CET', or as you say with format (Intl.DateTimeFormat options). Pressing it opens the same moment in each zone, the viewer's own zone first and tagged 'You' (added at the top if it is not among zones, and read from the browser when viewerZone is not given: nothing depends on the server's zone), each with the time, the date, the distance from UTC in tabular digits ('UTC+1', 'UTC−7', 'UTC+5:30') and 'Next day' or 'Previous day' where the date differs from the event's. Offsets and dates are worked out for the actual date by Intl, so daylight saving is right on both sides of a change of clocks. The head of the list gives the event's day and, measured from now (pass it for server HTML), 'in 5 days'. Copy as text puts one line on the clipboard ('Halcyon product sync: Mon 26 Oct, 17:00 Amsterdam (UTC+1) / 09:00 San Francisco (UTC−7) / ...', with a date where a zone is on another day) and says Copied. align, open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control the popover, LocalTimePanel is the inside on its own, and labels translates every word.
